reason: My whole shop already runs on the WhatsApp group, the boys send photos and updates there and customers are used to it, so I don't see why I should pay 2,499 a month to change something that works. Maybe I'd let the founder set up the free month, but I don't expect my technicians to put 7 out of 10 jobs through a new app in peak-ish work, so I don't see myself paying.
objection: My technicians will not change their habit. They already complain about sending photos; one more app, one more button, and after two weeks they will go back to WhatsApp and I will be chasing them instead of the jobs.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another Chennai AC service shop my size whose technicians actually use it every day, and proof that the automatic AMC renewal reminders brought back renewals I would have missed.
